**Are you ready to take ownership of financial planning and performance management in a global MedTech company?

**Do you thrive at the intersection of finance, strategy, and business partnering? Are you able to translate complex financial data into clear insights and recommendations for senior management? And do you enjoy contributing to projects and initiatives that drive business performance and improve financial processes?

Then you could be Ambu's next Senior FP&A Business Partner.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Senior FP&A Business Partner, you will join the FP&A team within Business Finance & Analytics, covering FP&A, Commercial Finance, Strategic Finance, Operational Finance, and BI & Data Science. Reporting to the Senior FP&A Manager, you will play an important role in shaping Ambu’s financial planning and performance management processes while contributing to executive decision-making across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you will work closely with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and Executive Management. You will own key planning activities, drive performance insights, and support cross-functional initiatives that contribute to Ambu's continued growth and transformation. The role offers a unique opportunity to combine financial expertise and business partnering in an international environment with exposure to senior leadership and strategic priorities.

This position provides an excellent platform for further development within Business and Strategic Finance.

**

• Owning key elements of the annual financial planning cycle, including budgeting, forecasting, and target setting.

• Driving parts of cross-functional planning and performance management processes in close collaboration with Finance, Commercial, Operations, and functional leadership teams.

• Analyzing business performance and providing actionable insights, recommendations, and decision support to senior management.

• Preparing and presenting financial analyses and performance updates for Executive Management while driving management and Board reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate, and consistent delivery.

• Have experience driving projects or workstreams involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

• Are analytical, structured, and proactive, with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills. Experience with Power BI, Copilot, or other AI-enabled finance tools is considered an advantage.

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team

Location: Farum, Denmark | Level: PhD / Postdoc / Experienced Engineer

The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

At Ibsen Photonics, we are developing Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures. We are looking for creative, hands-on Optical Design Engineers to take full ownership of designing, building, and optimising our SBC platform.

This role bridges the gap between theoretical physics and industrial reality. You won’t just design on a screen; you will spend significant time in the lab, iterating rapidly from proof-of-concept to robust, production-ready, scalable systems.

Key responsibilities:

• Design & Assemble: Develop compact, efficient SBC modules using Ibsen’s world-class transmission gratings, while considering optical beam paths, thermal effects and mechanical constraints.

• System Optimisation: Drive performance by refining optical alignment, mechanical stability, and complex thermal management for high-power loads in a reiterative process: design – experiment – optimise.

• Characterisation: Use advanced diagnostics to maintain beam quality (low M²) during power scaling, including wavefront sensing and spectral analysis.

• Full Lifecycle Ownership: Source optical/mechanical components and manage the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs.

• Global Collaboration: Work closely with an internal team and international partners, including potential overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing.

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a “build-test-learn” environment. Ideally, you possess:

• Education: A PhD or Postdoc in Optics, Photonics, Laser Physics, or a related field.

• Expertise:

• Hands on experience with (high-power) fibre and free-space optical systems, precise alignment, and experimental troubleshooting.

• Understanding of (and ideally experience with) SBC and CBC beam combining techniques.

• Beam quality measurement and analysis.

• Mechanical design of low-tolerance devices

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Gaussian optics, beam propagation, and high-power laser effects (thermal lensing, runaway-effects, mitigation strategies).

• Software Skills: Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g., Zemax) and familiarity with mechanical CAD.

• Mindset: Independent enough to drive a project and work on your own, but collaborative enough to thrive in a flat-hierarchy, cross-functional team, sharing insights and discussing projects/next steps. The role is highly experimental and hands-on, requiring independence and a strong drive to make systems work in practice, not just on paper.

• Security Clearance: You are a European citizen with no family ties to Russia or Russian allied territories, and you have a clean criminal record.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• High Impact: Your designs will directly shape the future of high-brightness laser systems for manufacturing, defence, telecommunications, and science.

• Freedom to Innovate: We value experimental drive—if you have a better way to align or stabilise a system, we want to see it.

• Danish Engineering Culture: Enjoy a supportive environment with fast decision-making, real ownership, and a healthy work-life balance.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Ecommerce Manager to join Hårklinikken as we continue to develop and grow our global ecommerce business.

We operate six Shopify sites across the US, UK, EU, Denmark, Iceland and the UAE, with the US representing our largest growth market.

You will own how we present and sell Hårklinikken online, shaping a seamless and engaging experience that helps clients explore our offerings, find what is right for their individual needs and take the next step in their journey with us.

At the same time, you will own the sales plan and use data and customer behaviour to identify opportunities, improve conversion and continuously optimise the online experience. From merchandising and product launches to CRO, consultation booking, first purchase and the ecommerce roadmap, you will be responsible for making our sites commercially strong, seamless and easy to use.

Success in this role means delivering against the sales plan and continuously improving conversion rate, AOV and revenue across sites and markets.

Alongside commercial performance, you will ensure our sites are fast, stable and easy to use, working closely with our web agency and tech team to continuously improve the experience for our clients.

Primary Relationships

You will report to the Global Director of Ecommerce and work closely with the CRM & Lifecycle Manager as part of our ecommerce team in Copenhagen.

You will also collaborate closely with Brand, our clinics and Operations, particularly around merchandising, launches and the customer journey.

Externally, you will work closely with our web agency, technology team and relevant ecommerce partners.

Key Responsibilities

• Trading across six sites. Own the sales plan for each site, with campaigns and offers adapted to each market, and contribute to ecommerce forecasts throughout the year.

• Merchandising and launches. Determine what we feature and where to drive effective cross-sell and upsell. Coordinate online product launches with Brand, clinics and Operations, while keeping stock availability and our delivery promise on track.

• The CRO roadmap. Identify where we lose clients, develop and run tests, and roll out what works.

• The ecommerce backlog. Set priorities together with the Global Director of Ecommerce, brief our web agency and tech team, and manage incoming website requests, including knowing when to say no.

• The first step of the customer journey. Own and optimise the consultation booking flow, sign-ups, onsite offers and first purchase, in close collaboration with the CRM & Lifecycle Manager.

• E-tailers, SEO and GEO. Manage the day-to-day activities and relationships with relevant external partners.

Core Competencies

This role requires strong ecommerce experience combined with a hands-on, structured and analytical approach. You are comfortable owning your numbers, identifying problems through data and translating insights into clear priorities and actions.

You enjoy taking ownership and making decisions. You are comfortable saying no to the wrong request when necessary and can clearly explain the reasoning behind your priorities.

You don’t need to tick every box to be the right fit. We would love to hear from you if you bring strong ecommerce experience, a commercial mindset and a genuine drive to continuously improve the customer experience.

What You Bring:

• 5+ years of experience in ecommerce, with full ownership of a webshop’s trading and conversion.

• Deep Shopify experience, ideally Shopify Plus across multiple storefronts or markets.

• Experience with subscriptions in ecommerce, ideally Recharge.

• A strong CRO track record, with experience running tests and demonstrating their impact without compromising the brand.

• Strong GA4 and Shopify analytics capabilities, with the ability to identify problems and opportunities through data before looking for a solution.

• Experience leading agencies and developers through a roadmap and backlog.

• Fluent English.

• A structured approach, strong ownership of your numbers and the confidence to prioritise and say no when needed.

It is an advantage if you also have:

• Hands-on Amazon experience, ideally Seller Central in the US.

• Experience working with the US market.

• Experience working with a premium brand within beauty, wellness, fashion or lifestyle.

• Proficiency in a Scandinavian language.

Who Are We?

Founded in 1992 in Copenhagen, Hårklinikken is a leading scalp and hair health clinic with more than 30 years of experience. We help clients achieve optimal scalp health and long-lasting hair gain, combining expert guidance with clean and gentle products formulated to support healthy hair growth.

Our approach began with Hårklinikken’s founder and lead researcher, Lars Skjøth, who developed a diagnostic, consultation-based approach centred around understanding each client’s individual scalp and hair needs. Today, The Hårklinikken Method brings together decades of expertise with the personalised care that has been at the heart of Hårklinikken from the beginning.

Clients come to us in different ways, whether through a consultation or by discovering and purchasing our products online. Through virtual consultations or in person at our clinics in New York, Beverly Hills, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Dubai and Reykjavik, our Hair Specialists combine their expertise with an individual assessment of each client’s scalp, hair, lifestyle and environment to create a personalised regimen designed around their specific needs.

However their journey begins, we are here to guide and support our clients along the way. From helping them find what is right for their individual needs to supporting them in achieving the best possible results, we want every client to feel confident, understood and cared for throughout their Hårklinikken journey.

We’re on a mission to help as many people as possible achieve fuller, stronger, healthier hair with products that are powered by science, perfected by experts and proven by over 100,000 clients.

What We Offer

• A new team, where you shape how we work from day one

• Full ownership of six sites in six markets

• Short decision paths in an owner-led company

• Close work with our clinics, where the treatment starts

• A real work-life balance, with flexibility in how you plan your day

• An international team and modern clinics with a strong focus on quality and aesthetics

• Growth opportunities in a safe work environment

• Pension, holiday allowance and discounts on our products and treatments

The role reports to the Global Director of Ecommerce and is based on site in Copenhagen. It is a permanent, full-time position, starting as soon as possible.

Questions? Contact Emma Cronwall Trampedach at +45 3133 5432.

DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for a colleague to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

Imagine seeing your automation solutions come to life in pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients. In our DCS Automation team, deep DCS expertise meets real process understanding – and you'll be at the centre of it.

Why you'll enjoy working here:

• Greenfield projects at scale: An exciting pipeline of large, data-driven greenfield plants with modular, scalable designs.

• The full automation lifecycle: Consultancy, design and development, implementation and validation of automation solutions for the pharma and biotech industries.

• Real process depth: Work across API production areas such as fermentation, recovery and purification, utility and cleaning systems.

• Room to innovate: Our solutions are built on a deep understanding of our customers' production processes – and when standard components can't do the job, we develop our own.

• A strong professional community: 80+ DCS Automation colleagues in Denmark and 200+ globally, from graduate engineers to senior specialists and leads.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Application Specialist, you'll join a diverse, collaborative team where no two days look the same. You will:

• Shape the control systems. Design, develop, implement, qualify and support Process Control Systems, using your deep PCS/DCS expertise and your hands-on feel for how client plants really run.

• Stand side by side with the client. Work closely with the client's Operational Responsible and operators, from the first design discussions through to commissioning.

• Solve problems where code meets equipment. Track down and resolve whatever shows up when the software meets the physical plant.

• Fine-tune to the finish line. Optimise the processes until they are ready for final handover.

• Connect with experts across disciplines. Exchange ideas with process experts and colleagues who specialise in MES, historian systems, instruments, production equipment and more.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Respectful of your colleagues’ individual and cultural differences

• Aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Engineering foundation: A degree in electrical, automation, process or marine engineering – or equivalent experience

• Hands-on DCS skills: Proven experience designing and coding PCS/DCS applications, ideally in ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine

• Batch know-how: Understanding of batch production and ISA-88 – or a strong drive to build it quickly

• Regulated or project experience: Experience from GMP/GAMP environments or from executing automation projects – and you find the complexity of GMP/GAMP meaningful

• Cross-disciplinary mindset: You collaborate easily with process experts and colleagues working on MES, Historian, instrumentation and production equipment

• Digital and AI-savvy: You use AI tools, scripting (e.g. Python) and smart engineering tools to work faster, standardise and reuse solutions

• Future-oriented: You are motivated by modular, data-driven and scalable automation design

Why choose NNE?

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Develop and own the company's leadership development program(s), scaling them from pilot to company-wide availability at speed.

• Develop content and facilitator materials, aligned with Operations training and Culture on the shared learning platform.

• A builder who creates a pilot and take it to company-wide availability at speed

• A facilitator who energises a room, from a bar back room to the office meeting room

• A partner who cooperates and influences across Operations, Culture, People Business Partners and regional T&LD without needing authority

• Curious and data-led: you want proof that training changes behaviour and results

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• Proven track record designing and delivering content and facilitator materials, incl. blended or digital learning for leadership programmes, including coaching and feedback modules

• Hands-on facilitation experience, ideally with train-the-trainer or certification programmes

• Experience measuring training impact and linking it to performance outcomes

• Leadership experience and/or relevant education

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Job Description

Are you interested in the intersection of IT, business and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will work with IT solutions supporting banks' corporate credit processes. You will analyze system issues, understand client needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions while building specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our team, working with IT solutions that support banks' corporate credit processes. You will be involved in the daily operation, maintenance and further development of these solutions, acting as a link between clients, developers and other stakeholders. Your work will involve investigating issues, understanding business needs and ensuring reliable system operations.

You will join an experienced team that will support your onboarding and help you build expertise within corporate credit and IT solutions. Initially, your focus will be on learning the existing solution and its daily operations, with opportunities to take on more responsibility for further development over time.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Handling and analyzing client-reported issues and tickets, investigating problems and identifying their root causes to ensure reliable system operations.

• Maintaining and supporting existing IT solutions while contributing to their continuous improvement and further development.

• Engaging in dialogue with clients to understand their needs and challenges, translating business requirements into clear and actionable tasks.

• Collaborating closely with developers and testers to investigate technical issues, clarify requirements and coordinate solutions.

• Supporting the development and implementation of new functionality through requirements analysis, testing and refinement.

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how IT solutions work and how they support business processes. You enjoy investigating problems, asking questions and finding solutions in collaboration with others. You are comfortable communicating with different stakeholders and can translate complex issues into clear and actionable tasks.
